builds.name: Feast champion damage ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Feast champion damage within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Feast champion damage within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R3 champion Feast is650+0.5AP+0.1 Stat12[statFormula=2] true damage. Source bonus-health term and Riftmaker HP-to-AP justify HP/AP; no penetration benefit. Heartsteel has exactly500 earned bonusHP, Warmog amplifies itemHP, and Riftmaker converts bonusHP toAP with8% full-ramp damage. Deathcap/Zhonya strengthen AP. Shadowflame penetration helps only magic, never true damage; amplification requires runtime verification. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.

Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.

kitEvidence.formula: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing [300 / 475 / 650 + (0.5) × AP + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] true damage to champions or [1200 + (0.5) × AP + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain [80 / 120 / 160] max Health. Only [6] stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.
